title: A Lasting Trait, a Past Result
goal: Say how a lasting trait would have changed a past event with si + imperfect subjunctive and habría + participle.
grammar: Mixed conditionals: lasting condition, past result

items: I can say how a lasting trait would have changed a past event with si + imperfect subjunctive and habría + participle.
